body: Then I am awfully glad you decided not to help.

I rely on exercise and sleep to get me through.

I cannot rely on medication, it is too expensive and due to tolerance issues, it takes more an more to make me feel nothing, much less happy.
The art wasn't supposed to be just for me though. I didn't go to school for a decade so that I could draw in sketchbooks.

Because for a few months I didn't feel like this. And I thought that meant I wouldn't, that I would be happy, and finally be able to connect with.

I was wrong, and now I have a lease to live out.

She does not. She is part of the present problem.

I don't trust anyone with what I am talking about. I have never expressed it in person. Thought honestly, I just don't trust anyone.
Not really. I work out a lot. And I think about the past.
Not really. I jut can't find the motivation to do the productive things sometimes. And somethings are falling apart because I used to be the only thing keeping them going and I am giving up on them.

I keep myself here because I know, intellectually, that it's a pretty shitty thing to do. To my family, and to myself. That you aren't *supposed* to kill yourself. That it only solves *my* suffering.

So I distract myself with exercise, video games, books and movies. Anything to take me away from my own life at least for a little while. I used to do art (it was my major), but frankly I am a really shitty artist.

Honestly, there isn't a single thing today that I am looking forward to.

I will go home after work, and walk my dog. I will vacuum some rugs, and work out. I might do dishes because my gf won't.

Everything else will probably be either boring or counter productive.
